Former FBI Director James Comey has been charged with threatening the life of US President Donald Trump, a formal accusation that stems from an image he briefly shared on social media.
WASHINGTON — Former FBI Director James Comey was indicted again Tuesday, this time by a federal grand jury for threatening to kill President Trump in a May 2025 Instagram post that called to “86 47.”

According to the New York Post, the former FBI director was indicted Tuesday by a federal grand jury on allegations that he threatened President Donald Trump in a May 2025 Instagram post featuring the numbers “86 47.”
